grammarRule.formula: Although / Even though + Clause, Main clause | Clause. However, clause

explanation.ml: രണ്ട് പരസ്പര വിരുദ്ധമായ കാര്യങ്ങൾ ഒരുമിച്ച് പറയുമ്പോൾ 'Although' (എന്നിരുന്നാലും / എങ്കിലും), 'However' (എങ്കിലും / പക്ഷെ) എന്നിവ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു.
explanation.en: Master Contrast Connectors: Although, Even though, However with clear formula: Although / Even though + Clause, Main clause | Clause. However, clause

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: 'Although' ഉം 'but' ഉം ഒരേ വാക്യത്തിൽ ഒരുമിച്ച് ഉപയോഗിക്കരുത്. 'Although it was raining, we went out' (NOT 'Although it was raining, but we went out').
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: 'Although' ഉം 'but' ഉം ഒരേ വാക്യത്തിൽ ഒരുമിച്ച് ഉപയോഗിക്കരുത്. 'Although it was raining, we went out' (NOT 'Although it was raining, but we went out').

nouns.definition: A thing that blocks one's way or prevents or hinders progress.
nouns.example: Lack of funding was the primary obstacle facing the scientific venture.

nouns.definition: The capacity to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness.
nouns.example: The island community displayed extraordinary resilience following the monsoon flood.

nouns.definition: In spite of that; notwithstanding; all the same.
nouns.example: The journey was arduous and exhausting; nevertheless, the hikers pressed onward.
Severe budgetary constraints forced the school board to postpone library renovations.

nouns.definition: Persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay in achieving success.
nouns.example: Through patient perseverance, the research scholar deciphered the ancient script.
Unforeseen supply shortages caused temporary delays on the construction site.

sentences.text: Even though he endured seven solitary months without seeing another human soul, his mental fortitude never faltered.

traps.question: Which of the following sentences has a double conjunction error?
options: Although it was expensive, they bought the equipment.
It was expensive, but they bought the equipment.
Although it was expensive, but they bought the equipment.
Even though it was expensive, they purchased it.
traps.explanationMl: 'Although' ഉം 'but' ഉം ഒരേ വാക്യത്തിൽ ഒരുമിച്ച് ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നത് തെറ്റാണ്. 'Although it was expensive, they bought the equipment' ആണ് ശരി.

traps.question: Choose the sentence that correctly uses 'However' between two independent clauses:
options: The flight was delayed however we arrived on time.
The flight was delayed. However, we arrived on time.
However the flight was delayed, but we arrived on time.
The flight was however delayed we arrived on time.
traps.explanationMl: 'However' പുതിയൊരു വാക്യമായി തുടങ്ങുമ്പോൾ അതിനു ശേഷം ഒരു കോമ (comma) നിർബന്ധമാണ് ('The flight was delayed. However, we arrived on time.').

traps.question: What is the meaning of 'nevertheless'?
options: In spite of that / All the same
traps.explanationMl: 'Nevertheless' എന്നാൽ 'അങ്ങനെയാണെങ്കിൽ പോലും / എന്നിരുന്നാലും' (In spite of that) എന്നാണ് അർത്ഥം.
